details: Since 2017 VRChat had a lot of Romanians playing the game, but sadly there was never a good place to talk with all of those people because there's simply not a place to do that, the official discord doesn't have it. I and some other people created discord and a map trying to get to know them all and make new Romanian friends but we think there should be support from the VRChat Team. So our point is that there should be a Romanian Category in the Official VRChat Discord like with the other languages, also an option on the website to select it as a language you speak. We can also help translate the game in Romanian
title: VRChat Romanian Community
